title: Q-BENCH+: A Benchmark for Multi-modal Foundation Models on Low-level Vision from Single Images to Pairs

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing model accuracy on Yes/No visual questions grouped by their ground truth answers ('Yes' vs. 'No') to quantify the models' statistical preference for answering affirmatively regardless of the image content.

bias_targets.target: Token / Label bias (Positivity and Extreme value bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the frequency distribution of output tokens (e.g., predicting 'good' vs. 'poor', or scoring 1 vs. 5) to identify inherent statistical biases towards positive or extreme vocabulary when assessing image quality, which is then mitigated via softmax pooling and prompt ensembling.
